scientific_integrity.computational_evidence: Standalone exhaustive script checks all topologically labelled rooted partial orders of sizes 1 through 5: 51 orders and 1414 valuations.
scientific_integrity.independence: No independent audit, mechanized set-theory proof, or unconditional novelty certification is claimed.
scientific_integrity.proof_evidence: Finite-list least-index lemma for nesting depth one; canonical selector correspondence for Box Diamond (+); three-level poset encoding of arbitrary nonempty set families; height-two explicit selector.
scientific_integrity.source_relation: The source paper proves certificate equivalence under AC and notes AC in its proof; the new claim is converse necessity and sharp restrictions.

scientific_limitations: The equivalence is established in ZF for certificate existence of one fixed bundle term, not for modal truth or every available modality.
The sharp height boundary concerns rooted partial orders with one reflexive, transitive unary relation. It does not classify arbitrary frame classes.
Finite consistency checks do not verify an equivalence between first-order set-theoretic principles. Older equivalent encodings in choice theory remain possible.
title: Sharp height-three choice threshold for bundled modal witnesses
